summary: Connect ESG data with financial statements, controls, and disclosures. Explore practical IFRS S1 and S2 reporting workflows. View the course outline.
lede: Strategic ESG integration in financial reporting connects material sustainability information with financial statements, estimates, and disclosures. For finance, sustainability, and reporting professionals, it offers a practical way to link ESG matters to reporting decisions. Participants practise mapping material topics to financial effects, assessing climate-related assumptions, tracing data, and designing controls for consistent disclosures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who connect sustainability information with accounting judgments, financial disclosures, reporting controls, or management decisions.
prerequisites: Prior experience with financial reporting, sustainability reporting, or ESG data workflows is recommended. You should be familiar with financial statements and routine reporting responsibilities. No coding or programming is required.
